sections.title: Privacy notice
sections.summary: What happens to the details you give us.

blocks.p: This notice starts with the form for our engineering software, because that is where most people share their details.

blocks.h: When you request our engineering software

blocks.p: The Intelligence Lab lets you ask to try our desktop programs. The form asks for:

ul: The program you are interested in (optional)

blocks.p: We use these details to email you the download link you asked for, and to reply if you write back about the software. The form asks for nothing else.

blocks.h: Where your details go and how long we keep them

blocks.placeholder: Where form submissions are stored, who can see them and how long they are kept. Waiting on the company's choice of email, Google Sheet or CRM.

blocks.h: If you send a project inquiry instead

blocks.p: The same form also takes project inquiries. Those add a message and details about your project, which we use to reply to you and to prepare a proposal.
You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the details you gave us by writing to {email}.

blocks.placeholder: Whether this site uses cookies or analytics, and for what. Not decided yet.

sections.title: Terms of service
sections.summary: The rules for using this website and our software.

blocks.p: By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use it.
The website describes Archi Hub's studio work, its process and its engineering software. It is there for information, and we may change or remove content at any time.
The text, images, drawings and project material on this site are owned by Archi Hub or used with permission. Please ask us before you copy or reuse any of it.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.summary: What our software and our examples do and do not promise.

blocks.h: Software results are not a signed design

blocks.p: Our programs help engineers plan and check building designs. Their results are not a finished or approved design on their own. A qualified engineer must review them and take responsibility for a design before anything is built from it.
The projects and results shown on this site illustrate our process. Every project is different, and showing one does not promise the same result for yours.
We work to keep this site accurate, but we cannot promise that it is complete or up to date. It is not professional advice for your own building.
